'''Erkeere Ridge''' was a mountain range that bisected the largest continent on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Auratera/Legends|Auratera]]. Meandering from the north pole to the planet's south pole, the Erkeere was an unbroken chain of tall, mountains that resembled a maw of teeth from space. The tallest mountain, [[Dran's Peak/Legends|Dran's Peak]], was a ritualistic site used by the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] visiting the nearby [[Vergence/Legends|vergence]] at [[Acablas/Legends|Acablas]].<ref name="NoP" />
